description: This file defines a service module providing functions to retrieve leaderboard, achievements, and streak data from a backend API. It includes a safe request wrapper for error handling and fallback data, and exports three functions as the public interface.

methods.name: safeRequest
methods.description: A helper function that executes an asynchronous function and returns fallback data or result, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: getLeaderboard
methods.description: Fetches the leaderboard data from the API with an optional timeframe filter, providing fallback data on failure.

methods.name: getAchievements
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's achievements with fallback data in case of API failure.

methods.name: getStreak
methods.description: Gets the user's current and best learning streaks, with fallback data for error resilience.
